name: Linkvertise
description: Membuka tujuan HTTPS dari parameter link yang tersedia.
script: function resolve(input) { var r=input.query.r; if(!r) return null; try { var target=atob(r); try {target=decodeURIComponent(escape(target));}catch(e){} return {url:target}; }catch(e){return null;} }

attribution.note: Adapted local r-parameter branch only; external resolver paths are excluded.
